label: PF Backlog 633
title: Fix: Gate 1 check must treat unparsable/empty review evidence as indeterminate (fail-closed)

brief.problem: A Gate 1.5 review whose text fails to section parses to zero findings and silently PASSes the binding Gate 1 check (fail-open).
brief.what_adds: A parsed_ok marker on evidence + indeterminate handling in gate_view/gate1_check.
brief.why: A binding gate must fail closed when evidence is unreadable, not treat it as clean.

objective: Make Gate 1 fail closed on unparsable/empty review evidence instead of silently passing.
acceptance_criteria: The review ingest records a parsed_ok flag that is true only when the raw review text contained at least one severity/SUMMARY heading.
gate_view and gate1_check treat parsed_ok=false as indeterminate (exit code 2), never as PASS, so evidence that failed to parse cannot clear Gate 1.
Backward compatible: committed evidence files without parsed_ok are treated as parsed (true); a genuinely clean review with headings still passes.
A test covers unparsable evidence -> exit 2, no evidence -> exit 2, and parsed clean evidence -> exit 0.
in_scope: Fix: Gate 1 check must treat unparsable/empty review evidence as indeterminate (fail-closed)
approach: Fix: Gate 1 check must treat unparsable/empty review evidence as indeterminate (fail-closed)
verification: Objective achieved: Fix: Gate 1 check must treat unparsable/empty review evidence as indeterminate (fail-closed)
